description: Haruhisa Nakata is a Japanese manga artist best known for creating Levius , a steampunk-inspired series that blends mechanical boxing with post-war dystopian themes. Originally serialized in Ikki magazine in 2012, Levius gained acclaim for its intricate artwork and philosophical undertones. Nakata continued the story with Levius/est in 2015, expanding the universe and deepening its emotional and aesthetic complexity. He also contributed original character designs for anime such as Fairy Gone and Lupin III vs. Cat's Eye , showcasing his distinctive visual style beyond manga.
